# Nextwise Markets

> The Nextwise Markets Ltd. provides access to forex, metals, energy, indices and selected cryptocurrency markets through a MetaTrader 5 trading experience. Trading leveraged products carries significant risk and is not suitable for every investor.

Official website: https://nextwisemarkets.com/
Client portal: https://client.nextwisemarkets.com/
Support: support@nextwisemarkets.com

## Company locations

- Registered office: Ground Floor, The Sotheby Building, Rodney Village, Rodney Bay, Gros-Islet, Saint Lucia.
- Representative office: Office 3002, 30th Floor, Iris Bay Tower, Business Bay, Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
- Dubai representative-office phone: +971 58 676 5113.
- Company registration number: 2025-00221.
